_doc: Wilderness set pieces, round 5: props of Ember Creek Hot Springs (w5_hot_springs_bathhouse), an old timber hot-springs bathhouse resort. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild5_springs.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild5_springs.py; materials game/data/materials/props_wild5_springs.json (the spring water and its steam). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Floor props stand on their origin with their depth centred on it; wall props hang with their origin on the wall plane. rooms: w5_springs keeps them out of the builder's scatter.

defs.name: Plunge Pool
defs.description: The bathhouse's plunge pool: a basin of small white tiles raised knee-high in a cedar-capped surround, steps down at one end, a brass rail and an overflow grate, the spring's mineral water steaming in it (worn: tepid and grey with scum, towels floating, the tiles crazed).

defs.name: Rock Pool
defs.description: An open-air hot pool walled with mossy boulders and mortared stone where the spring wells up: a timber step down into it, a soaked duckboard and the water steaming (worn: silted and green, barely warm).

defs.name: Steam
defs.description: Warm mineral steam hanging over hot water in soft, slow veils.

defs.name: Steam Room Bench
defs.description: Two tiers of slatted cedar benches built against the steam room wall, the lower one a step to the upper, darkened by sweat and steam (worn: furred white with the Bloom along the slats).

defs.name: Bloom Bank
defs.description: The Bloom grown up a steam-soaked wall: a thick white felt of mycelium from the floor to head height and shelves of pale caps through it, glowing faintly green in the dark.

defs.name: Bloom Mat
defs.description: A low cushion of Bloom felt spreading over wet tiles, a troop of pale caps standing in it and glowing at night.

defs.name: Bathhouse Boiler
defs.description: A riveted horizontal firetube boiler on a brick setting: the firebox doors and ash pit at the front, a pressure gauge and water glass, the safety valve and steam main on top and the flue going up through the ceiling (worn: rust bleeding from the rivets, the fire long out).

defs.name: Spring Cistern
defs.description: A tall stave tank of cedar bound with iron hoops where the spring is piped up out of the rock: a cover of boards, a float gauge, the feed pipe in and the hot main out, mineral crust down its sides.

defs.name: Boardwalk
defs.description: A section of cedar boardwalk laid on sleepers in the ground, the boards silvered and slick with moss at the edges (worn: boards split and missing).

defs.name: Towel Shelf
defs.description: A tall painted cubby shelf for the bathers' towels and robes, a stack in every square and a basket of soap on top (worn: the towels pulled out, mildewed).

defs.name: Changing Bench
defs.description: A slatted bench with a tall back board of pegs over it, robes and a towel still hanging on the pegs (worn: the robes on the floor).

defs.name: Cabin Key Board
defs.description: A varnished board of brass hooks behind the desk for the cabin keys, each on a wooden fob, the cabin numbers painted over the hooks; most of the hooks are empty.

defs.name: Cedar Soaking Tub
defs.description: A deep oval soaking tub of cedar staves bound with copper hoops, a step and a brass tap piped from the spring (worn: dry, the staves sprung).

defs.name: Spring Main
defs.description: Lagged hot-water mains and a cold feed run along the wall on iron brackets, with gate valves, a thermometer well and a pressure gauge (worn: the lagging hanging off in rags, mineral crust round the joints).
